page.layout: One block of verse in the centre of the page; running head at top with page number at left; catchword "Quod" at lower right below the last line.

main_text.p:
Certum monstrat iter, tende lubens, simul
Segnes tolle moras. Duce

Quid caelo metuis? Quid Polyandrium
Patrem Iane times sequi,

Quem clarat pietas, quem celebrat fides
Christi nutibus obsequens?

O, nunc turpe scelus pellere destina,
Et furua tenebras stygis,

Passim Romulidum quas violentia
Sparsit Pontificum impotens,

Et lucis supera non patiens furor.
Ne quid splendidius putes

Quam seruire Deo, Caelituum & pati
Promptis pectoribus iugum:

Atque illos meritis tollere honoribus.
Foelices ter & amplius

Puram syderea queis face veritas
Mentem lustrat, ut inclytis

Errorum valeant monstra laboribus
Debellare ferocia,

Et nubem dubiis demere mentibus
Quae solis iubar aureum

Fusc t perpetui, sacraque lumina:
Nec cerni patitur viam,

Quae certo Superum lactea tramite
Sedes ducit ad arduas.

Et summa referat praemia gloriae.
Laudatur vagus Hercules,

page.notes: The catchword "Quod" is printed at lower right. Several letters in the scan are faint or damaged (e.g. "Fusc t", "Fœlices", "lucis"), transcribed as best read; "Fusc t" may be a damaged "Fuscat" and is uncertain.
